name: Triplasiella
look_here_first: LOVEGRASS TRIDENS: a fine open, arching and widely spreading lovegrass-like panicle with tiny dispersed spikelets, unlike compact narrow Tridens heads. Confirmation requires a mature 3-veined lemma, glumes and ligule under magnification, not merely a large airy grass panicle. Historical synonym Tridens eragrostoides is NOT another canonical species.
